description: The dataset holds 20 iNaturalist observations of hoverfly Asemosyrphus mexicanus with GBIF IDs and full taxonomy. It lists country codes (MX, CO, GT), state/province, and coordinates from –0.37 to 20.76 ° lat and –105.48 to 0 ° lon, with up to 243 m uncertainty. Dates span 2017‑2026; metadata records publishing organization, catalog numbers, observers, identifiers, a CC‑BY‑NC‑4.0 license, and notes still‑image media with coordinate‑rounding and missing taxon‑ID issues. Researchers can map hoverfly distribution, study seasonal trends, and aid biodiversity monitoring and conservation.
